findings.title: Keep pure command planners and one staged native publisher

evidence.claim: Command planning clones state/resources, checks host sequence, reserves inputs, freezes draws/effects and validates before return.
Envelope composition validates before one storage write; caller publishes after success.
Save-owner gates and prepared gameplay/unlock/equipment/ownership projections precede storage; live publication follows it.
Predicate facts are derived from the canonical instance without a persisted mirror.

findings.current_player_behavior: Existing commands can stage actual money/items/XP and saved state through a shared durable boundary. That source structure does not by itself prove current gameplay.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: Extend planners with typed references and selected domain adapters while preserving one native/save integrator. A simple purchase still settles in one command.
findings.authoritative_owner: Shared Engine owns runtime/publisher; assigning master alone changes the canonical plan.

concrete_world_example.case: One paid kit or workshop job uses existing owners; an acquired organ is a richer optional command on the same host.

acceptance_case: Deferred: successful paid work updates stock, money and actual native outcome together.
Deferred: failed storage leaves durable bytes/live owners/draws unchanged; reload keeps exactly one settlement.
Architecture review: no second inventory, per-book engine or independently publishing UI path.
findings.verification_limits: Static source inspection only; no import, build, game suite, browser or save execution. Acceptance cases are a deferred backlog, not passed tests.
findings.delta_from_macro_micro: Macro/micro endorse reuse; this audit makes the alternative architecture decision explicit and ties it to the actual native preparation path.
findings.simplify_retain_alternative: Prefer ordinary records plus pure functions. A full ECS, event-sourced world rewrite or database replacement has no demonstrated need here; bounded receipts can coexist with snapshots. No cost saving is measured.

findings.title: Bind commands and all world effects to actual instance endpoints

evidence.claim: Detached endpoints have world/instance/region/layer and instance/definition/continuity/era identity.
Current host validates exactly one Glasshouse instance and empty duplicate world facts.
Canonical fact/site routing is Glasshouse-specific.
Command/participant contact checks use worldId and string locations, not full instance endpoints.
fact(scope=world) directly writes world-domain facts; explicit world effects route via the Glasshouse hook.
Expansion world domain resolution and predicate projection also use context.worldId.

findings.current_player_behavior: The bounded Glasshouse has a guarded canonical owner. General commands cannot distinguish two simultaneous histories with the same worldId and location label; alternate fact effect forms do not share its routing.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: A registered endpoint resolver binds actor/body, target/site and command to one actual instance. Every world-fact write resolves that owner, rejects a missing binding, and uses one explicit namespace. Location text remains display data.
findings.authoritative_owner: Shared Engine owns endpoint/domain/native bindings; world GM declares local regions/layers and contact rules.

concrete_world_example.case: Two authored branches both contain a Village workshop. A worker in branch A must not reserve branch B stock or observe its repaired roof.

acceptance_case: Deferred: same worldId/location in different instances rejects ordinary local transfer/contact; an explicitly supported cross-instance channel remains possible.
Deferred: each admitted fact effect form changes the same bound instance or rejects before cost publication.
Deferred: target/instance drift after preview rejects, and return refers to unchanged canonical identities.

source_invention_uncertainty.verified: Current detached endpoint support and Glasshouse-only native bridge.
source_invention_uncertainty.proposal: Generic resolver and validated reference join.
source_invention_uncertainty.unknown: No multi-instance native enrollment or passage permission is approved.

findings.verification_limits: Static source inspection only; no import, build, game suite, browser or save execution. Acceptance cases are a deferred backlog, not passed tests.
findings.delta_from_macro_micro: Micro C7/ME08 already require endpoints. New detail is the exact legacy fact write bypass and the need to cover both effect interpreters, not just visit creation.
findings.simplify_retain_alternative: Adapt the existing manifests and realm hooks behind a small host interface. Keep base.frontier as an explicit legacy binding; do not copy all native domains into every instance or infer passage from an endpoint.

findings.title: Give shared source grant/removal one declared lifecycle policy

evidence.claim: Expansion grant replaces expired sources; removal deletes only actor.sources.
Simulation grant uses existing source/faculty records via ||=; simulation removal deletes both source and faculty.
Faculty validity requires a corresponding actor source; stored power revisions are positive but not compared to live definitions.
Expired sources and inactive faculties do not supply capability contributions.

findings.current_player_behavior: Equivalent-looking source effects have different expiry/regrant/removal semantics. A simulation regrant can retain an expired record; removing a faculty-backed source through the expansion path leaves an invalid faculty reference. These are static reachable edge cases, not a reproduced current content failure.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: Both command families call the same lifecycle primitive for the same source policy. Expired reacquisition explicitly rejects or establishes a new acquisition receipt/term, with declared retained training/activation behavior. Removal updates the operative binding and its faculty dependency together.
findings.authoritative_owner: Shared Engine owns common lifecycle/invariants; Ability/world owners declare source-specific renewal, training and donor consequences.

concrete_world_example.case: An original finite teaching-support source expires, is legitimately acquired again, then removed while its learned method remains.

acceptance_case: Deferred: either command family follows the selected renewal rule and cannot leave an expired source masquerading as renewed.
Deferred: either legal removal leaves no executable orphan faculty; retained learned information remains distinct.
Deferred: duplicate cause at clock zero does not duplicate an acquisition or grant.

source_invention_uncertainty.verified: Different grant/removal code and expiry/validation consumers.
source_invention_uncertainty.unknown: Whether reacquisition retains awakening/control is a local policy, not selected here.

findings.verification_limits: Static source inspection only; no import, build, game suite, browser or save execution. Acceptance cases are a deferred backlog, not passed tests.
findings.delta_from_macro_micro: New concrete interpreter discrepancy beyond the baseline organ/source identity requirements. The baseline clock-zero cause-dedupe warning is retained, not presented as newly discovered.
findings.simplify_retain_alternative: Share only common owner/lifecycle operations; do not merge every effect interpreter or force sources into one universal acquisition/awakening ladder. Preserve genuine functions and source-specific exceptions.

findings.title: Join entity identities with native stock semantics before rich physical records

evidence.claim: Spawn distinguishes personId from definitionId/revision but keeps one actor/person binding.
Body changes are scalar; native vitals require an actual adapter.
Custody transfers template-key quantities; physical specimen identities are absent.
Native equipment consumes/returns bag stock, while simulation equipment references owned stock without moving it.
Current person/inventory/equipment/custody validation forbids a second native inventory but does not validate the proposed component graph.
C1/C2 propose person/body/component identity, host binding, lots and conservation.

findings.current_player_behavior: Current stock keys/quantities work for ordinary items and current equipment conventions. Scalar body/source fields cannot distinguish two same-type specimens or a detached item from installed support.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: Keep actor IDs. Add actual body/component/lot IDs only where selected mechanics need them; represent one physical placement plus separate legal claimant/custody, definition revision, provenance and host/socket or container reference. Binding-specific aggregate projections account for whether worn stock is inside or outside bag counts. Validate graph joins before publication/import.
findings.authoritative_owner: Shared Engine owns identity/stock/native codecs and invariants; Bodies/Items/Ability owners declare physical and functional rules.

concrete_world_example.case: Two original fitted lenses of one template have different damage and custody; one is fitted and the other stays in storage. Removing the fitted lens returns that same specimen.

acceptance_case: Deferred: each unique component occupies one declared physical state; attachment changes actual supported actions and no bag duplicate appears.
Deferred: a loaned lot portion cannot consume a personal portion by whole-key accident; split quantities and provenance reconcile.
Deferred: malformed duplicate placement/missing host references reject before live/native load.

source_invention_uncertainty.verified: Current definition/person split, scalar bodies and differing equipment stock conventions.
source_invention_uncertainty.proposal: Minimal typed relationship graph and native projection join.
source_invention_uncertainty.unknown: No new organ/socket/lot schema or anatomical policy accepted.

findings.verification_limits: Static source inspection only; no import, build, game suite, browser or save execution. Acceptance cases are a deferred backlog, not passed tests.
findings.delta_from_macro_micro: Micro defines the richer records. This audit adds the migration/native accounting trap: native worn objects leave the bag, simulation worn objects remain references. One generic bag-plus-equipment count invariant would double count one representation.
findings.simplify_retain_alternative: Preserve anonymous aggregate ordinary stock where properties are fungible. Instantiate a lot on meaningful provenance/condition/reservation differences, and a component on meaningful physical identity; no compulsory ID for every coin or abstract skill.

findings.title: Make due time and simultaneous boundary order explicit

evidence.claim: Jobs store due as joined state.clock plus duration.
Job validation compares due with joined state.clock.
Instance elapsed time is reconciled through existing presence/activity planners.
Glasshouse context gates new caretaker decisions by local activity; it does not change paid job due time.
Host order reconciles realm/observation, expansion jobs, opportunities, chronicle, then simulation boundary.
Simulation boundary settles jobs before conditions/life/end-of-offer work.

findings.current_player_behavior: Local elapsed freeze and authorized activity exist, while paid jobs and periodic simulation work use joined played time. Existing ordering is deterministic but split across scheduler families, not a declared universal simultaneous-effect rule.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: A due-work record names its clock owner/unit and time basis. Resolve only authorized intervals; world-local work cannot finish during unsupported absence unless its declared policy allows that. Give interacting domains an explicit stable tie-break policy and preserve current ordinary job behavior. Body-carried upkeep follows its actual host/pool clock.
findings.authoritative_owner: Shared Engine owns clock conversion/scheduler/order; world/Ability owners select local timing and specific simultaneous exceptions.

concrete_world_example.case: A new explicitly local repair pauses outside supported room activity, while a paid Frontier service retains joined-clock completion. A traveling body source and a stored material use different interval authorities.

acceptance_case: Deferred: unioned presence/leases advance one local interval, not one per observer; no unsupported elapsed work or retroactive reward.
Deferred: a job, source expiry and upkeep at the same timestamp settle in the declared stable order across one large or several small advances.
Deferred: leave/return/reload preserves the due basis and remaining obligation.

source_invention_uncertainty.verified: Existing freeze/activity scaffolding, joined jobs and exact current cross-family order.
source_invention_uncertainty.proposal: Clock references and explicit domain-order extension.
source_invention_uncertainty.unknown: Absence, body-time ratios and source-specific simultaneous policies are not selected.

findings.verification_limits: Static source inspection only; no import, build, game suite, browser or save execution. Acceptance cases are a deferred backlog, not passed tests.
findings.delta_from_macro_micro: Micro already flags ME08 and jobs-before-conditions. This audit adds the due validator change, explicit interval owner and cross-family ordering that a local scheduler adapter must cover.
findings.simplify_retain_alternative: Keep one scheduling authority and integer played-minute foundation initially. Use a fixed policy table and clock resolver for selected cases; no independent timers, offline simulation or general time algebra is required by this audit.

findings.title: Separate prepaid frozen outcomes from live phase obligations

evidence.claim: Commands freeze participants, costs, effects, RNG and due time.
completeJob applies frozen effects then claims/completion/site release, without general current support/consent/contact checks.
Generic cancellation refunds original costs or forfeits them.
C4 already proposes phase receipts, live continuation, irreversible boundaries and ordered settlement.

findings.current_player_behavior: Ordinary prepaid jobs finish from committed effects. Applying this policy to changing physical support or irreversible operations can settle stale outcomes or throw repeatedly at the same boundary.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: A command declares frozen-prepaid or live/phase-bound settlement. Only meaningful irreversible steps need individual receipts, used/unused escrow and exact relevant dependency revisions. Changed support yields a persisted paused/interrupted outcome with a legal resume/cancel path, instead of an endlessly retried invalid completion.
findings.authoritative_owner: Shared Engine owns phase settlement/occupancy/escrow; world/Ability/Body owners declare consequences and meaningful rechecks.

concrete_world_example.case: An original fitted-device procedure has a completed extraction/detachment step. A later fitting step loses access to the worker or supported tool; it pauses without restoring prior anatomy or consumed supplies.

acceptance_case: Deferred: ordinary kit-preparation keeps its declared paid-finish behavior.
Deferred: loss of actual participant/source/permission before an irreversible step stops that future step and settles unused escrow once.
Deferred: already published injuries, outputs and time survive interruption/reload; resume does not reroll or repeat a receipt.

source_invention_uncertainty.verified: Frozen job/cancellation path; no generalized dynamic phase delivery.
source_invention_uncertainty.proposal: Refine existing Micro C4 into an explicit settlement mode and terminal interruption result.
source_invention_uncertainty.unknown: Exact consent/refund/failure rules remain local reviewed decisions.

findings.verification_limits: Static source inspection only; no import, build, game suite, browser or save execution. Acceptance cases are a deferred backlog, not passed tests.
findings.delta_from_macro_micro: Explicitly retains Micro ME04 rather than claiming discovery. The extra contract detail is preventing a thrown completion from stranding the scheduler indefinitely and requiring resume support to be re-established.
findings.simplify_retain_alternative: One-step paid jobs need no six-state workflow. Phase only the operations whose outputs, refunds, support or interruption differ; do not automatically revalidate every historical prepaid entitlement.

findings.title: Declare native write ownership and projection order

evidence.claim: Envelope overlays money/calendar/vitals/gameplay/ownership/unlock/equipment then arbitrary allowed nativePatch paths.
Native preparation is centralized, but post-write publication invokes several ordered projections.
Native resets can replace an envelope, patch selected paths and require reload.
Current passage stages both actor/person location and current-location save patch.

findings.current_player_behavior: Current root composes bounded native adapters and validates the resulting envelope. Structural validity alone cannot detect a future adapter overwriting another owner with a different but valid value. The present doorway patches are location-specific; no collision is claimed for them.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: Each adapter declares read/write domains and semantic authority. Reject overlapping incompatible writes or require an explicit reviewed override that rebuilds the final plan/projection. Derive native actor/body/equipment/vitals from the same candidate after modifiers are resolved; validate all joins before storage. Native reset may use the existing reload strategy.
findings.authoritative_owner: Shared Engine alone owns native envelope/publication and adapter arbitration; specialist modules return detached plans/patches.

concrete_world_example.case: An original equipment fit changes maximum stamina while a paid action spends stamina. Save/live projection must agree on both effective maximum and remaining reserve. A new reset must not silently overwrite an item transfer.

acceptance_case: Deferred: incompatible overlapping native writes reject before storage; explicit legal reset overrides have one resulting plan and native projection.
Deferred: item/equipment/body/vital/location joins agree in saved envelope and live state after publication/reload.
Deferred: missing reconstruction or failed storage leaves no partial costs/projection.

source_invention_uncertainty.verified: Current ordered composition, prepared publication and location/reset producers.
source_invention_uncertainty.proposal: Small declared write-set/owner contract, not a new storage system.
source_invention_uncertainty.unknown: No current corrupt-save or partial-publication failure was executed.

findings.verification_limits: Static source inspection only; no import, build, game suite, browser or save execution. Acceptance cases are a deferred backlog, not passed tests.
findings.delta_from_macro_micro: Micro ME10 calls for atomic new-record projection. This audit adds semantic overlap detection and distinguishes valid-shaped conflicting values from serialization failure.
findings.simplify_retain_alternative: Start with a static owner table and a few explicit overrides. Do not add general distributed transactions, save storage services or universal path patch permissions for worker modules.

findings.title: Version operating definitions separately from save shape

evidence.claim: Sources record revisions, but registry checks existence rather than revision compatibility.
Saved source capability grants resolve through current definitions.
Job effect snapshots are frozen; power cooldown is read from the current power definition.
Completion audience fallback reads the current command group.
World instances require exact definition revision and exact sites/fact bindings.
Energy learning freezes its policy and later recovery/use consumes that owned policy.
Existing expansion migrations are additive; absent state grants no new enrollment.
Structural/realm validation and preserved retirement precede active loader mutation.

findings.current_player_behavior: Existing schema migration and strict world-definition guards are valuable. Different record families use live definitions, frozen payloads or exact revisions, so a reused ID after a rule change can reject or change behavior despite the same outer save schema.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: For each persistent family declare live-compatible, frozen-operating or explicitly migrated revision semantics. New namespace schemas and definition manifests are validated before activation; active jobs retain necessary operational and observer fields. Unsupported revisions reject recoverably or stay dormant under an explicit policy, never silently grant/replace content.
findings.authoritative_owner: Shared Engine owns save compatibility/activation; world/Ability/Items owners provide rule revisions and migration intent. Director accepts incompatible changes.

concrete_world_example.case: A definition update adds a site while an old instance and paid command remain saved. A teaching-source update changes its grant without changing the source ID.

acceptance_case: Deferred: old save with absent optional data gains no person/item/source/reward.
Deferred: a paid job/source uses its declared compatible/frozen/migrated rules, including audience and source grant; no accidental silent revision swap.
Deferred: unsupported shape/definition revisions preserve original bytes and prevent active/native mutation; unrelated dormant/retired data stays recoverable.

source_invention_uncertainty.verified: Mixed current revision semantics, existing migration/rejection and retirement preservation.
source_invention_uncertainty.proposal: Per-family compatibility matrix and active payload completeness.
source_invention_uncertainty.unknown: No new schema number, automatic migration or general source-world retirement policy is approved.

findings.verification_limits: Static source inspection only; no import, build, game suite, browser or save execution. Acceptance cases are a deferred backlog, not passed tests.
findings.delta_from_macro_micro: Macro/micro request migration. The missed distinction is schema-shape versus operational definition revision and mixed late reads in otherwise frozen work.
findings.simplify_retain_alternative: Pin only the operation fields that truly need historical semantics, or supply a named migration. Do not persist a whole definition library in every save or promise universal compatibility with every future build.

findings.title: Keep base state, operative contributions and derived values distinct

evidence.claim: Body effects set scalar fields; vital effects clamp to existing supplied maxima.
Owned energy policy supports fixed capacity, discrete recovery/use/refund and strain.
Conditions store intensity/expiry and optional copied periodic effects.
C3 requires independent channels, typed stacking and explicit overflow/clamp policy.

findings.current_player_behavior: Scalar body properties, fixed owned pools and ticking conditions support bounded authored behaviors. They do not supply general reversible composition of host modifiers, source upkeep or derived native physiology.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: Store actual base pool/body state and cause/source-bound contributions; derive effective capacity/recovery/output/strain/suppression through declared channel composition. Removal invalidates only that contribution. Feed one derived result into actual execution and native projection; capacity loss uses an explicit clamp/overflow rule, while reserve and receipts remain actual state.
findings.authoritative_owner: Shared Engine owns derived-state/native joins and selected continuation primitives; Ability/Bodies/world owners choose channel rules and genuine functions.

concrete_world_example.case: An original fitted aid lowers recovery while a separate support effect supplies continuous upkeep. Rest, removing the aid and ending support alter different terms; an expressly inexhaustible source remains inexhaustible under its own supported conditions.

acceptance_case: Deferred: removal restores only its own modifier and does not erase unrelated training or refill reserve.
Deferred: recovery reduction versus upkeep produces distinct declared reserve histories and meaningful remedies.
Deferred: a capacity change resolves overflow once; unsupported upkeep pauses/stops under policy without negative reserve or repeated failed settlement.

source_invention_uncertainty.verified: Scalar/fixed/ticking scaffolding, not a composed physiology engine.
source_invention_uncertainty.proposal: Targeted contribution resolver and projection join.
source_invention_uncertainty.unknown: All numerical formulas here remain unspecified original rules; no universal balancing penalty or exclusivity is selected.

findings.verification_limits: Static source inspection only; no import, build, game suite, browser or save execution. Acceptance cases are a deferred backlog, not passed tests.
findings.delta_from_macro_micro: Micro already names the separate channels. This audit supplies the authoritative base/contribution/derived split needed to remove or recompute effects without destructively editing base values.
findings.simplify_retain_alternative: Use a pure resolver over only selected contributions, with fixed composition phases and specialized policies where necessary. Keep ordinary sources on existing fixed records; do not simulate every organ or force true exceptional functions into generic damage multipliers.
